prompts.A:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production directional animation spritesheet for Burning Hills, a richly painted isometric garden town game. Reference image is ONLY a character identity / clothing / painted texture reference, NOT its incorrect eye-level camera and NOT its atlas layout. Produce a genuinely transparent RGBA PNG with EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS (30 separate fully visible sprites), uniform cells, generous transparent gutters, NO background, NO shadows, NO ground, NO grid, NO text, NO numbering. Each cell contains the SAME character with identical proportions, clothes, face, accessories and scale. Fixed orthographic camera 35 degrees ABOVE the ground looking down: crown of head and tops of shoulders visibly shown, bodies foreshortened consistently, no eye-level view. Direction changes are true rotations of the entire body in 3D, not a head turn. Row1 character walking toward bottom of screen, directly TOWARD camera, FRONT VIEW. Row2 walking toward lower-right, FRONT RIGHT THREE-QUARTER. Row3 walking toward right edge, RIGHT SIDE PROFILE with top of head/shoulder visible. Row4 walking toward upper-right, REAR RIGHT THREE-QUARTER, mostly back of head and back of jacket visible, NO front-facing face. Row5 walking toward top edge, directly AWAY from camera, BACK VIEW, absolutely no face visible. The six columns in EACH ROW are chronological distinct phases of one seamless complete locomotion cycle: left-foot forward contact, left support/recoil, right leg passing, right-foot forward contact, right support/recoil, left leg passing. Hands swing opposite legs; feet really alternate, no duplicate static poses. Stable pelvis centered in each cell, consistent ground baseline, no sliding body across cells, subtle natural vertical movement only. High quality clean detailed hand-painted 2.5D illustration, warm upper-left light, no heavy outline, crisp silhouettes. Characters occupy no more than 78 percent of each cell with 15 pixel or larger transparent margins, all heads/hands/shoes/accessories wholly inside. Highest available output resolution.
Subject: the adult woman in the reference's upper-left cells: brown hair in a bun, terracotta jacket, cream blouse, green cropped trousers, brown walking shoes, canvas grocery bag with flowers. Keep this SAME woman in all 30 cells. Rebuild her walk with actual alternating feet and correct elevated views.

Each row must read as a six-frame looping WALK CYCLE, not a lineup of duplicates. COLUMN 1 keep left foot forward, right foot back. COLUMN 2 left foot planted directly under hips, right knee bent and right heel lifted behind body. COLUMN 3 RIGHT KNEE LIFTED and crossing forward in front of left leg, feet nearly together beneath hips, left supporting leg straight. COLUMN 4 opposite contact: RIGHT FOOT FAR FORWARD and LEFT FOOT FAR BACK (must visibly swap which trouser leg and shoe is in front); arms opposite column1. COLUMN 5 right foot planted under hips, left knee bent with heel behind. COLUMN 6 LEFT KNEE LIFTED and moving forward, feet nearly together, right supporting leg straight. In right-facing rows the foot-to-foot span MUST vary clearly: wide, medium, NARROW, wide, medium, NARROW. Animate bag/arms naturally; do not change outfit, camera, face, colors or body scale. Stable torso center and ground baseline in every cell. Preserve all five rows exactly: front, front-right, right side, back-right, back. Maintain 6x5 layout, nothing clipped, enlarge transparent gutters. Truly transparent background with clean antialiased edges, no colored matte, glow, contamination, noise, backdrop, ground, shadows, grid or text.

prompts.D: Use case: stylized-concept. Production directional CYCLING animation atlas for Burning Hills. Reference image supplies the young cyclist's identity, green vintage bicycle, tan vest, cream rolled-sleeve shirt and green trousers. Correct its camera to ORTHOGRAPHIC 35 degrees ABOVE ground, looking down, visible tops of head, shoulders, bicycle saddle and basket. EXACTLY 6 COLUMNS by 5 ROWS, 30 isolated complete sprites on genuine transparent RGBA, consistent character/bicycle size and ground baseline, large empty gutters, no shadows or background or labels. Each row contains the SAME rider and SAME bicycle at six successive pedal angles: 0,60,120,180,240,300 degrees. The near foot traces a circle around the crank, knee bends and extends; the far foot is always 180 degrees opposite. Wheels, frame, saddle, rider torso/head/arms and handlebar stay aligned and stable across the row. Both wheel hubs always fixed; bike never stretches or changes shape. Wheel spokes rotate too. Row1 front view, FRONT WHEEL closest to bottom edge, rider heading down toward viewer. Row2 front right three-quarter heading lower right, front wheel to lower right of rear wheel. Row3 RIGHT PROFILE heading right, front wheel on right and rear wheel on left. Row4 REAR RIGHT three-quarter heading upper-right; see rider's BACK, rear wheel closest to viewer, front wheel farther away in upper right. Row5 BACK VIEW riding away toward top edge, no face, rear wheel nearest bottom and front wheel farther toward top. Bicycle must turn together with rider; never ride backwards, never draw side-on bike in a front/back row. High-end hand-painted 2.5D garden game illustration, warm natural light, painterly realistic materials, same style as reference. Real changing bent/extended knees and correct pedaling. Six unique pedal positions per row. Consistent full figure scale, clean alpha, no clipping, no glow, no colored matte. Highest resolution.

Preserve identity, bike and colors.
